data.name: Make the Empire Great Again
data.detailed_description:
Play as a pioneering lord—vanquish monsters while building a thriving city, and make the empire great again!

Build Your City

The city’s future lies in your plans. Construct various buildings to meet your people’s needs: housing, work, entertainment, safety, and health. Earn satisfaction to upgrade the city, develop unique industries, attract more residents and tourists, and forge the greatest imperial city!

Gathering, Manufacturing, and Services

Gathering: On the honeycomb-patterned world map, collect resources like crops, timber, livestock, fish, and minerals. Adapt to diverse natural environments to secure survival!

Manufacturing: Within the city, build factories, research recipes, and produce goods to meet domestic needs and export abroad. Seize opportunities to monopolize formulas, lead technological revolutions, and become a manufacturing tycoon!

Services: Erect various facilities to enrich your people’s leisure and draw visitors from afar. Most importantly—squeeze every coin from their pockets. The empire has grand uses for it!

Fight for the Empire, Relieve the People

Requests already clutter your desk—monsters rage unchecked, disputes scream for fixing, neighboring nobles are sitting on little secrets they’d rather bury, and the village privy’s about to plug up again! Hire adventurers to solve them at once!

During quests, adventurers make choices based on their stances and personalities, affecting relationships, event outcomes, and possibly bringing back unexpected results.

Turn-Based Auto-Battles

The ancient empire adheres to time-honored combat. Flexibly assemble teams, skills, and equipment to tackle monsters, dungeons, and claim higher-quality loot—until you defeat the final boss!

data.short_description: A simulation + turn-based auto-battle game. The "Dusk Apocalypse" nears; the empire teeters! Your people need food, work, maybe some thrilling fun. But monsters seize Your lands, plunder Your fields & mines! Fight, reclaim lost! Build, forge grandest! Fear not the "Dusk", for a new "Sun" has risen!
